what_happened.task: Full audit of Moralis API coverage followed by Sprint 1 implementation: graduated token feed, new token feed, native ERC-20 pair lookup, per-pair stats, and webhook signature verification hardening.

what_went_well: Only ~35% of available Moralis endpoints were being used — comprehensive audit revealed 12+ high-value gaps.
The graduated token feed (GET /discovery/tokens/graduated-by-exchange) is the single most time-sensitive EVM discovery signal — catches tokens within minutes of bonding-curve graduation.
Native GET /erc20/{address}/pairs completely replaces DexScreener for pair lookups — eliminates an external dependency and reduces latency.
GET /pairs/{pairAddress}/stats provides per-pair buy/sell velocity at 5m/1h/24h — more precise than the aggregated pair stats already wired in.
Moralis signature verification was already using the correct keccak256(compact_json + secret) spec — no security regression.
Response shape normalization pattern (_parse_tf inner function) handles both nested {field: {tf: val}} and flat {field_tf: val} formats — robust against API changes.
discovery_priority_order: 0. Buying Pressure — most time-sensitive (already first, confirmed correct)
7. New Listings — NEW: earliest signal, extra scrutiny via new_listing=True flag

architectural_decisions.graduated_before_filtered: Graduated tokens placed at priority #1 (after buying pressure) because post-graduation tokens are the alpha window — they're real, have DEX liquidity, and are not yet widely discovered.
architectural_decisions.new_listings_at_end: New listings are lowest priority because they have no track record. Extra scrutiny applied via new_listing=True flag in scorer.
architectural_decisions.per_chain_exchange_map: _CHAIN_EXCHANGE_MAP in discover_tokens maps each chain to its dominant DEX — aerodrome for base, camelot for arbitrum, pangolin for avalanche. This ensures correct exchange slug per chain.
architectural_decisions.native_pair_fallback: If aggregated pair stats don't capture liquidity, the native pair lookup fills it in. Belt-and-suspenders approach.
architectural_decisions.top_pair_stats_override: When analytics_data is absent, per-pair stats buy_pressure_1h is used as the buy pressure signal — prevents zero fallback.

key_insights.response_shape_normalization: Moralis API returns inconsistent shapes across endpoints (nested vs. flat, snake_case vs. camelCase, wrapped vs. unwrapped). Pattern: always try all known key names with fallback to 0/empty. _parse_tf() handles the time-frame dimension of this problem.
